what: Northrop Grumman builds military aircraft, space systems and defence electronics. It is the prime contractor for the B-21 Raider bomber and the Sentinel intercontinental missile programme, and it makes satellites, radars and solid rocket motors.
customers: The US Department of Defense and intelligence agencies above all, plus allied governments.
money: satellites, launch vehicles and the Sentinel missile programme
the B-21 bomber, Global Hawk and other aircraft
moat: Classified programmes and security clearances that take years to obtain, plus sole-source positions on strategic systems like the B-21 and Sentinel.
risks: The fixed-price B-21 contract produced a loss of over a billion dollars
The Sentinel missile programme has run far over its original budget
Almost all revenue comes from US government budget decisions
Space launch competition from newer entrants is intensifying
opportunities: The B-21 moves into production lots where terms are better than the development phase
Solid rocket motor and munitions demand has risen sharply
Allied defence budgets in Europe and Asia are expanding
watch: B-21 production margins and the resolution of Sentinel programme restructuring.
